title: #409 – Matthew Cox: FBI Most Wanted Con Man – $55 Million in Bank Fraud
summary: Matthew Cox is a former con man who served 13 years in federal prison for bank fraud, mortgage fraud, and identity theft. He is the author of many books, including his memoir Shark in the Housing Pool, and runs the YouTube channel Inside True Crime.
